notes.en: A maintenance release: internal updates only, with no changes to how ClipMenu works. · ClipMenu is built on an updated version of the shared Dragon App code. About's Credits row now reads DragonKit v3.4.0. That row is the only observable difference — no behaviour, setting, shortcut or stored file changes.

A maintenance release: internal updates only, with no changes to how ClipMenu works. · ClipMenu now checks for updates from its own repository rather than the website, so a problem with the website can no longer hold up an update.

A small fix for anyone who installed ClipMenu with Homebrew. · Uninstalling from Settings now clears Homebrew's record of ClipMenu too, so installing it again with Homebrew works instead of being refused as already installed.

A maintenance release: every fix is in the local development build, and the shipped app is unchanged. · The development build could have reached the production update feed, which would have replaced it with the public app. It can no longer check for updates at all. · The development build wrote its saved actions into the installed app's folder, so testing on a developer's Mac edited the real action set — or wrote the defaults over it on first launch. It now keeps its own.

Housekeeping only — no user-facing change. · A checked-in build number was two releases stale. It was inert, because every build path overwrites it before the app is assembled, but it read like a real version and invited someone to trust or "fix" it. It is now an obvious placeholder.
